phrase-note:hello: In natural speech, the first third tone changes before another third tone: 你好 sounds like ní hǎo. We keep the dictionary spelling nǐ hǎo.
phrase-note:student: 學 means study, and 生 appears in words for people who study. Learn 學生 as a complete word.
phrase-note:identity: 我 + 是 + 學生: I + am + a student. 是 stays the same for I, you, and other subjects.
phrase-note:question: 你是學生嗎？
Put 嗎 at the end of the statement 你是學生 to ask a yes/no question.
